responsibility: Implements Graphite’s polyhedral memory-dependence analysis on an already-built SCoP. It converts each polyhedral data reference in the scop’s polyhedral basic blocks into isl read, must-write, and may-write union maps constrained by statement domains and subscript bounds, invokes isl flow analysis on the original schedule, and stores the resulting RAW/WAR/WAW dependence relation in scop->dependence. It also provides the carries_deps helper that tests whether a candidate schedule carries dependences at a given scheduling depth, which is used to reason about loop parallelism and legality of schedule transformations.
